content: {"praised":["Curb Your Enthusiasm is one of the funniest shows ever.","The humor is sharp and relatable, especially for neurotic viewers.","Larry David's character is witty and engaging.","The show’s tone is comedic yet authentic.","Episodes are well-paced and entertaining."],"criticized":["The show lacks humor and fails to make viewers laugh.","Episodes feel repetitive and identical to each other.","Larry David’s acting is considered poor.","The writing and dialogue are unfunny and boring.","The show is self-aggrandizing and pretentious."]}
